research_scope: Middle Minoan Cretan Hieroglyphic seals and seal impressions; database designed for quantitative/qualitative recurrence queries.

project_policy: Use DBAS metadata to reconcile object identities and CHIC/CMS crosswalks. Treat its classifications as attributed scholarly data. Do not treat statistical associations or iconographic classifications as phonetic values or decipherment.
